title: Effect of Loading
statement: Let $W\in\mathbb{N}$, let $m:\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1\}^W$ be a memory, and let $i,j,a\in\mathbb{Z}$. Suppose the word at address $j$ is the $W$-bit encoding of $a$, and $a$ satisfies $-2^W\le 2a<2^W$. Then executing the load instruction with destination address $i$ and pointer address $j$ changes the memory to the function obtained by updating address $i$ with the word stored at address $a$.
